author: blu
body: Option A GOP probe: run the runtime spine, enumerate the USB bus (which drives the full xHCI bring-up + ownership handoff + port snapshot), then paint the captured xHCI diagnostic cells and halt. Boot under OVMF with -UsbDisk -UsbKbd -NoPs2 and screenshot to read what the bring-up saw on a real, spec-strict controller. Renders the diagnostic cells directly (no GopBoot, whose opening would collide with this one).

author: blu
body: The keyboard endpoint rows. Two lines, and every number on them is a PAIR: what the descriptor asked for beside what went into the endpoint context. `NOT READ` is a distinct reading from a zero -- a descriptor fetch that never happened and a bInterval genuinely zero are different answers and must not photograph the same.

author: blu
body: The mass-storage rows. `disk=n` on the ENUMERATED line has six causes and the rung says which one, so the two rows below are the ones to read when that letter is an n.
